alignment_variants.fallback: not time-synchronized (healthy window from another period)

header: Building-vibration check from discrete vibration codes. Each sensor's 10 s window (400 Hz) is encoded as 250 codes (12.5 frames/s, 2 interleaved codebooks). Codes describe waveform SHAPE only; level_rel_db gives each target's broadband level relative to the reference sensor (0.0 = same level). The reference sensor was recorded in a known-quiet healthy period from the same source dataset/reference pool. Reference and targets share a block/start time when recoverable; explicit fallback examples are not necessarily time-synchronized.
system: You are a building-vibration monitoring agent. Judge every target sensor strictly relative to a known-healthy reference window from the same source dataset. Windows are time-aligned when unambiguous source metadata and channel count permit; otherwise they are not necessarily synchronized. Answer with one strict JSON object, nothing else.

tails.multi:
Judge each target ONLY relative to the reference codes: report deviations in spectral content, impulsiveness, persistence or relative level that exceed normal ambient variation between windows. A level difference shared by reference and target alike is normal ambient variation, not a deviation. Use sensor_data_quality_issue for clipping or flatline/dropout evidence. Quality-only targets do not enter affected_sensor_ids and do not raise network_status; compute the network verdict from the remaining targets. In affected_sensor_ids, list every target with a mild_deviation or significant_local_deviation. Return one compact strict JSON object only, exactly this shape:
{"sensor_reports":[{"sensor_id":"target_1","local_status":"<sensor_label>"},{"sensor_id":"target_2","local_status":"<sensor_label>"},{"sensor_id":"target_3","local_status":"<sensor_label>"},{"sensor_id":"target_4","local_status":"<sensor_label>"},{"sensor_id":"target_5","local_status":"<sensor_label>"}],"network_status":"<network_label>","affected_sensor_ids":["<each deviation target id>"]}
